A highly recommended experience for anyone visiting Mumbai and wanting to understand the city’s incredible work culture and spirit.

Overall, Health Bag Meal combines user-friendly, hygiene, and delicious home-style food with excellent customer service. I’ve already recommended them to many and I will continue to do so!

featured_reviews.review_text:
A thali is a feast on a plate, offering a balanced mix of flavors, textures, and nutrients. Whether North Indian, South Indian, Gujarati, Rajasthani, or Maharashtrian, a well-prepared thali brings together sweet, spicy, tangy, and savory elements in a single meal.

Review of a Traditional Indian Thali

Presentation (5/5):
A thali is visually appealing, served on a large plate with multiple small bowls (katoris). The colorful variety of curries, vegetables, rice, and bread makes it inviting.

Taste (4.5/5):
Each component complements the other. The combination of dal, sabzi, roti, rice, chutney, pickle, and a sweet dish creates a satisfying balance. The spicy curries contrast beautifully with the cooling raita or yogurt. The use of fresh spices and ghee enhances the depth of flavor.

Variety (5/5):
The highlight of a thali is its variety. A North Indian thali might include paneer curry, dal makhani, tandoori roti, jeera rice, and gulab jamun, while a South Indian thali features sambar, rasam, poriyal, curd rice, and payasam. Rajasthani thali brings unique elements like dal baati churma and gatte ki sabzi

featured_reviews.name: Derrick D'Souza
featured_reviews.review_text:
After my wife's inability to cook due to orthopaedic issues, I was scanning the mobile for some outside caterer to fill in the void. And my eyes happened to see the food app " Tiffinkart " which instaneously caught my attention. I was not on the wrong track when I made my choice and both of us, decided to try out this catering avenue.
I got in touch with Mrs Sharmila and after a brief discussion about the rates and menu to go with, hit on her Tiffinkart app to get her to deliver food for us at our residence.
On the very first day of receiving her tiffin (one veg, the other non veg) we were delighted to see such mouth watering fare, vis-a-vis the price attached to it. oHer food is very tasty, and delicious and easily digestable. This Lady is very accommodating, kind, gentle and understanding towards the need of the hour.
However, my interaction with her made me feel like she is a family member. This is an added quality to the food she serves. No wonder a clientele stretches from Churchgate to Virar as far as I know.
Its amazing how this young, charming lady can meet the needs of those in need of good food to feed themselves.
My to all is that I have tried, tested and am still enjoying the meals coming from her gracious kitchen.
